title: Tether Hit With Lawsuit Over $2.76 Million Stablecoin Freeze
content: The payments firm alleges Tether froze its treasury wallet on its own initiative over a Brazilian investigation it has no connection to—and has profited from the reserves while refusing to release the funds for more than a year.

title: Pudgy Penguins' Ethereum Layer-2 Abstract Is Shutting Down
content: Abstract will shut down Dec. 15, saying a chain focused solely on consumer crypto proved unsustainable, and is urging users to bridge their assets off before then.

title: Circle Welcomes DJ Khaled to 'Team USDC' and Crypto Twitter Is Furious
content: Nothing in Circle's posts announces a sponsorship, but replies dug up Khaled's 2018 SEC settlement over a crypto fraud he promoted. The internet never forgets.

title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
summary: Bitcoin跌破84,000美元 因油價受伊朗油輪攻擊事件飆升 中東地緣政治風險升溫引發能源價格跳漲，牽動整體金融市場與Crypto的宏觀情緒。 Crypto 受宏觀風險與避險情緒影響，短線將加劇市場賣壓與波動性。 總體經濟影響 油價跳升推高通膨預期，增添Fed貨幣政策的不確定性。
